title: NBA suspends Clippers owner Ballmer for one year in Kawhi Leonard salary cap probe
summary: The NBA has imposed a one-year suspension on Los Angeles Clippers owner Steve Ballmer as part of an investigation into salary cap violations related to star player Kawhi Leonard. In addition to the suspension, the league has levied a hefty fine of $30 million against the Clippers and mandated that the team forfeits five first-round draft picks, one for each year starting in 2029. This decision underscores the league's commitment to maintaining competitive integrity and adherence to financial regulations.
